new: A frame-rate pass over the whole app, aimed at 90 Hz everywhere.

Automatic quality, on by default: when frames run late the edges of the view get coarser first, then the picture a little smaller; it comes back when frames are steady. Debug tab: Automatic quality on/off, and Foveation and Resolution start on auto.
A Quest 3S may drop to 72 Hz as the first step and returns to 90 Hz; other headsets use 72 Hz only as the last step.

Far fewer draws and uploads: people in a room (5 draws for everyone), station halos, the menu when you point at it, story panels and cards, the room scan that hides things, spaceships while none flies.
Stories: lighter scenes in the pass story, the cell map, the muscle, endotype, PET, ovary and microanatomy stories; shorter stalls while a story builds.

Three look changes: the cell map's organelles have no inner back wall, the muscle tower's haze is thinner, the pass story's sea has fewer, wider light shafts. People's visors take a little of their colour.
Studio: lighter frames in big scenes; sounds and videos stop when you leave; a scene's models are unloaded after 2 minutes away and load again when you return.

Behind the Stories screen and away from a circle the story no longer works in the background; narration is decoded only when it can be heard; a story is no longer swapped for an update in the middle of a session.
Headset logs carry frame times every 10 s, and the relay keeps them when they bring its password.
test: The frame-rate read-out (double press B or Y) in the lobby, in the studio with a big scene, and in the pass, muscle and cell map stories: is it at 90?
Debug tab, Automatic quality: which level it settles on in a heavy scene, and whether you see the steps.
On a Quest 3S: does it step to 72 Hz and come back to 90?
Leave a big studio scene for over 2 minutes (the lobby), come back: how long is the pause, is everything back?
People's name tags, heads and hands, and the stations' halos and icons from across a room.
Point over the menu's buttons and the Story tab: do the lit buttons draw right?
The three look changes and the play bar's clock: fine, or missed?
Narration after turning the sound on in a headset and on a phone.
untested: Every GPU gain: only script time, draws and uploads could be measured here, in software.
Automatic quality's thresholds and how its levels look; whether Quest Browser has requestViewportScale and honours it.
Instanced people and halos, the menu's patches and the merged room scan on a real headset and over passthrough.
The studio's unload and reload on a Quest, and its early model uploads.
The relay keeping headset logs on Coolify.
Measured worse here: the design room's first seconds and the robots' floor map; the lobby is at 48 draws, not the 40 aimed for.
Only the targeted tests ran; the full suites (shared rooms, live updates, update) run before main.
